name: ssl-bc2-parallel-smash
description: New-York / parallel drum smash via SSL Native Bus Compressor 2's built-in MIX: hit hard (10:1, low threshold, fast attack + fast release) then blend the squashed signal back UNDER the dry with the MIX knob to add density/sustain while keeping the dry transients. Measured: heavy GR at 100% wet, then MIX 40% recovers most of the dry peak (-11.5 -> approaching -1 dBFS).
intended_for: a drum bus / room that wants more body, sustain and aggression under intact transients
plugin_build: SSL Native Bus Compressor 2.vst3 (SSL Native; renders headless via Pedalboard — re-verify on a new machine)
notes: MIX (dry_wet_mix) IS the parallel control — 30-50% is the usual blend; 100% = fully wet (no parallel). mix_lock=true keeps your blend when auditioning presets.
Drive GR hard on the WET path (threshold low, fast attack 1-3 ms, ratio 10:1 / X) — the dry blended back restores the peaks. Re-dial threshold to the input level for heavy GR (8-12 dB).
Fast fixed release (0.3 s) adds pump/excitement; switch to AUTO for a smoother smash.
Verify the dry transient survived: peak/crest should stay close to source at your chosen MIX. If crest collapses, lower MIX or soften the wet path.
